title: 第25章 三千大道时间为尊第26章 开启新功能离别飞仙宗
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
“哦，没有吗？”
“那现在收不就行了？”
“楚依依，你可愿拜我为师？”
李如风转过头，朝着楚依依淡淡问道。
“收我为徒？”
“愿意，我愿意。”
“师尊在上，请受弟子一拜！”
楚依依听后，丝毫没有犹豫的就对着李如风跪拜下去。
这一幕，让一旁的未来楚依依脸色一僵，模样看上去有些尴尬。
“好，起来吧。”
“以后你便是为师的第三位弟子。”
“至于你以后修炼的问题，没有人比你自己教自己更合适。”
“你说是吧？”
说着，李如风又转头朝着未来的楚依依故意问道。
“你收徒，让我教？”
“那你做什么？”
“拜你为师，又有什么用？”
看着李如风那似笑非笑的模样，未来的楚依依此刻再也忍不住接连质问道。
“我啊，我可以救你。”
“怎么样，我还是有用的吧？”

李如风淡淡道。
“救我？”
“什么意思？”
未来的楚依依脸色一沉，语气认真的问道。
“你说呢？”
“你是未来的人。”
“若是过去的事情改变了，你觉得你还能继续存在吗？”
“你应该比我更清楚这个道理。”
“从你来到这个时代，与过去的自己接触后，蝴蝶效应就已经开始了。”
“你之所以还没消失，无外乎现在的变化，还没有影响到未来罢了。”
“因此，你消失是迟早的事情。”
“我说的对吧？”
李如风淡淡开口道。
“什么？！”
“大依依，这就是隐瞒我的事情？”
一旁的楚依依听到李如风的话后，顿时明白了所有。
“没错，正因为这样，所以我才不想告诉你。”
“而且，这其实也没什么需要告诉你的必要。”
“若是我消失了，这恰好说明，未来的结果在改变。”
“如此，我付出一切来到过去的目的，也就达到了。”

“我虽然会消失，但你不会。”
“这样，从某种层面上来说，我是不灭的。”
content_en:
"Oh, no?"
"Can't we just accept it now?"
"Chu Yiyi, are you willing to accept me as your teacher?"
Li Rufeng turned his head and asked Chu Yiyi calmly.
"Accept me as your disciple?"
"Yes, I do."
"Master, please accept my disciple's bow!"
After hearing this, Chu Yiyi knelt down to Li Rufeng without any hesitation.
This scene made Future Chu Yiyi's face stiffen and she looked a little embarrassed.
"Okay, get up."
"From now on, you will be my third disciple."
"As for your future cultivation, no one is more suitable than you to teach yourself."
"You think so?"
With that said, Li Rufeng turned to look at Chu Yiyi in the future and asked deliberately.
"You accept a disciple and let me teach you?"
"Then what do you do?"
"What's the point of worshiping you as my teacher?"
Seeing Li Rufeng's half-smiling look, Future Chu Yiyi could no longer bear to ask questions one after another.
"Oh, I can save you."
"So, I'm still useful, right?"
Li Rufeng said calmly.
"Save me?"
"What do you mean?"
Future Chu Yiyi's face darkened and she asked in a serious tone.
"What do you think?"
"You are the future."
"If things in the past change, do you think you can continue to exist?"
"You should know this better than me."
"The butterfly effect has already started since you came to this era and came into contact with your past self."
"The reason why you haven't disappeared yet is that the current changes have not yet affected the future."
"So it's only a matter of time before you disappear."
"Am I right?"
Li Rufeng said calmly.
"What?!"
"Da Yiyi, is this what you're hiding from me?"
Chu Yiyi on the side suddenly understood everything after hearing Li Rufeng's words.
"Yes, that's why I don't want to tell you."
"Besides, there is actually nothing necessary to tell you."
"If I disappear, it just means that the future results are changing."
"In this way, my purpose of giving everything to come to the past has been achieved."
"Although I will disappear, you will not."
"In this way, on a certain level, I am immortal."
